title: WILSON - a pathology foundation model framework for patient-level analysis and diagnostic text generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.25123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pathologists integrate morphology across magnifications and across the slides of a patient case, whereas pathology foundation models encode thousands of tiles from single slides and aggregate their features. Here we present WILSON, a vision--language foundation model that represents whole-slide images and multi-slide cases as single multi-magnification composite images, trained on approximately 189k slides from Mayo Clinic spanning 42 organs and 829 diagnostic entities using pathology reports as supervision. Without task-specific training, WILSON exceeded a dedicated case-level model on all internal cohorts (macro-F1 0.52 versus 0.38) and matched slide-level models up to 9.4 times larger at 272- to 2,155-fold lower compute. End-to-end fine-tuning on 508 triple-negative breast cancer cases improved histologic subtyping and stromal tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte grading by 0.16 and 0.11 macro-F1. WILSON retrieved matching diagnostic text

translated_title: WILSON——一个用于患者级分析与诊断文本生成的病理学基础模型框架
translated_abstract: 病理学家会整合不同放大倍数以及患者病例中多张切片的形态学信息，而现有的病理学基础模型则是对来自单张切片的数千个图块进行编码并聚合其特征。在此，我们提出了WILSON，这是一个视觉-语言基础模型，它将全切片图像和多切片病例表示为单一的多放大倍数复合图像，并以病理报告作为监督信号，在来自梅奥诊所（Mayo Clinic）的约18.9万张切片上进行训练，涵盖42个器官和829种诊断实体。在无需任务特定训练的情况下，WILSON在所有内部队列上均超越了专门的病例级模型（macro-F1为0.52对0.38），并以低272至2,155倍的计算量匹配了规模最大达9.4倍的切片级模型。在508例三阴性乳腺癌病例上进行端到端微调后，组织学亚型分型和间质肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞分级的macro-F1分别提升了0.16和0.11。WILSON能够检索匹配的诊断文本……
tldr: WILSON是一个视觉-语言病理学基础模型，通过将全切片及多切片病例表示为多放大倍数复合图像，无需任务特定训练即可在患者级诊断上超越专门的病例级模型，并以极低的计算成本匹敌大型切片级模型，同时支持诊断文本的检索与生成。
en_tdlr: WILSON is a vision-language pathology foundation model that represents whole-slide images and multi-slide cases as multi-magnification composite images, outperforming dedicated case-level models without task-specific training while matching far larger slide-level models at a fraction of the compute, and enabling diagnostic text retrieval and generation.
